verdict.rationale: Mirrors scores the effect of a correction using the team's own outcome labels, checks and customer feedback, compared against holdout groups. Nothing in the evidence describes configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators. Its docs also state that routing decisions run without model inference, and they position evals as the job of other tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith and Braintrust.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators
